name: evaporator_3_zones_plate_correlations
title: Three-zone plate evaporator with heat-transfer correlations (Thonon/Hsieh)
summary: Plate evaporator for R245fa heated by thermal oil (or glycol): three refrigerant zones (subcooled liquid, boiling two-phase, superheated vapour) sized with LMTD and plate-heat-exchanger correlations (Thonon single phase, Hsieh & Lin boiling); computes area, pressure drops and writes the zone boundary data into the 'ev' lookup table. Ships the auto-size source file of the same family as a variant (R123/water demo case).
language_features: lookup table write statements (dropped by CoolSolve, CS-BUG-LOOKUP-WRITE)

verification.reference: EES stored solutions of both source files (TM-0570: 21 variables; TM-0582 autosize variant: 30 variables). The stored values of the hx_ev outputs are stale in both files (call outputs stored as the EES guess 1; TM-0582 record internally inconsistent: A_ev = -0.948 vs A_l+A_tp+A_v = 9.610), so the reference covers the inputs and the simple computed quantities only.
verification.notes: Main file: 19 common variables, 4 differ (rtol=0.001) - p_ev 7.69e-03 (R245fa saturation pressure, EES 8 (2008) vs CoolProp backend, within the 'older EES fluid models' tolerance of ees_import.md section 11, consistent with CSL-0019/CSL-0112) and the three call outputs where the EES file stores 1 (stale guess, no reference). All inputs and identities (A, W_tot, L_w_tot) agree exactly. Outputs checked by energy balance (30.79 kW on both fluid sides) and a positive two-phase pinch of 6.4 K. Variant: 22 common variables, 5 differ (rtol=0.001) - all 17 agreeing variables are inputs, exact identities and h_sf_su_ev (water enthalpy, <= 0.1 %); the 5 differing outputs inherit the stale EES record and a demo case 1.95 K superheated at inlet (T_sat(2 bar) = 48.05 degC vs T_r_su_ev = 50 degC) whose zone duties cancel to a small residual, sensitive to the R123 backend. TM-0582's decoded 851x2 parametric table is mostly empty (leftover, not reproducible).
